summary: Radiopharm Theranostics Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing its Australian preliminary final report (Appendix 4E) for the year ended 30 June 2026. The report shows revenue fell 23.8% to A$2.77 million, while the net loss widened 50.3% to A$55.15 million, driven by higher R&D spending. Cash reserves dropped from A$29.1 million to A$4.14 million, and net tangible assets per share were negative. The company also increased its stake in joint venture Radiopharm Ventures LLC from 75% to 87.5%. This is a routine periodic financial disclosure, not a special-situation event.
